products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Fingerprint/face unlock (works on Class-2 sensors too), built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. NEW in v1.2.0: photo import and custom shortcut icons work on every phone (crashes root-caused and fixed), a professional step-by-step PIN setup, and fingerprint login that no longer says 'not available' on budget sensors. Also: disguise the app as Calculator, Notes or Gallery, or add a custom home-screen shortcut with any name and picture.

products.name: Ophelia Widgets
products.tagline: 23 hand-crafted widgets, now with the Ophelia signature set
products.description: 23 home screen widgets in 9 categories: the neon-gothic OPHELIA signature set (Ophelia Clock, crimson Battery ring, ornate Signature lockup), a self-ticking Digital Clock (4 themes, 12/24h), Analog Clock, Big Date, event Countdowns, Year Progress (the famous bar), Day Progress, live Moon Phase, World Clock (3 cities), Battery Ring, Weather for ANY city (no location permission), Sticky Notes, Daily Quotes, Flashlight, Quick Search, Settings Shortcuts, Photo Frame, Storage gauge, RAM monitor, Tally counter and a Decision spinner. Only two permissions in the whole app, both explained up front. New studio wordmark icon and Ophelia-branded theme.

products.name: Junk Cleaner
products.tagline: Advanced junk cleaner — smart clean, system cache boost, app cache dashboard
products.description: One-tap SMART CLEAN scans shared storage for thumbnail caches, empty folders, leftover installers and temp files — everything is shown for review before deletion, nothing is removed silently. SYSTEM CACHE BOOST uses the official Android storage API pattern (the same lever Google's own tools use) to make the system evict app caches device-wide — no root. The APP CACHES dashboard lists how much cache every installed app holds and deep-links you to each app's storage settings. Never touches Android/data, never deletes without review, no fake RAM/CPU 'boost' nonsense.
